In accordance with the advance notice requirements contained in the Company&#8217;s amended and restated bylaws (the &#8220;Bylaws&#8221;), stockholders wishing to nominate a candidate for election as a director or submit a proposal (other than pursuant to Rule 14a-8 under the Exchange Act) at the Annual Meeting must deliver notice to the Corporate Secretary of the Company at the Company&#8217;s principal executive offices at 1799 Innovation Point, Fort Mill, South Carolina 29715 no later than the close of business on July 3, 2026.
